title: SPE Symposium: Hydrogen and Hydrogen-Based Fuels🌍
excerpt: The global energy transition is accelerating — and hydrogen is taking center stage. Are you ready to be part of the movement?
body:
The global energy transition is accelerating — and hydrogen is taking center stage. Are you ready to be part of the movement?

We’re excited to invite you to the SPE Symposium: Hydrogen and Hydrogen-Based Fuels, happening this 11–12 June 2025 in Jakarta, Indonesia. This highly anticipated event brings together international experts, forward-thinking innovators, and leading energy companies to explore the evolving hydrogen landscape and its pivotal role in a low-carbon future.

### Why You Should Attend:

✅ Learn from Global Leaders – Hear directly from top hydrogen and energy transition experts as they share insights, technical breakthroughs, and real-world project case studies.
✅ Discover Cutting-Edge Innovations – Dive into the latest research, technologies, and solutions in hydrogen production, transport, storage, and its integration into existing systems.
✅ Network with Industry Powerhouses – Connect with key players including Pertamina, Marubeni, Air Liquide, Gentari, and many more. Whether you’re a technical specialist, policy maker, or investor, this is your chance to collaborate with those shaping the future of hydrogen.

From policy and project development to technical deployment and scaling challenges, this symposium is your gateway to understanding how hydrogen will fuel tomorrow’s energy systems — and how you can be part of it.

🎟️ Seats are limited and filling up fast. Don’t miss your chance — register today!
